fact: From 4 August 2026 the three Beninese operators withdrew the unlimited-style monthly plans at 5,000 FCFA (over 11 GB) and 10,000 FCFA (over 23 GB); the entry price for the continued-access benefit is now 15,100 FCFA for 20 to 25 GB, while the plain 5,000 FCFA plan still exists.
title: Hausse des tarifs data au Bénin : la réponse de l'ARCEP qui pose encore question
